claims.statement: REINS is operated by real-estate information network organizations designated by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism and shares property information among real-estate companies.
Member real-estate companies register property information based on client requests and other member companies can search it.
For exclusive-agency and exclusive-right-to-sell agreements, registration in REINS and delivery of a registration certificate are required under the Real Estate Brokerage Act.
A seller can use the seller-only screen to confirm registered information and transaction status for the seller's property.
The displayed transaction-status categories are public, written purchase application received, and temporarily unavailable for introduction at the seller's request.
Registration, search, and seller-side confirmation support information sharing and smoother real-estate transactions.
